events.title: Zap Colony Demo Updated for Steam Tower Defense Fest
events.summary: Hello everyone!Zap Colony is part of Steam Tower Defense Fest, and the demo has just received a major update! The biggest change is a completely rebuilt tutorial. One of the most common issues players had with the previous version was understanding the game’s core rule: tower color must match enemy color. events.title: Zap Colony Demo is LIVE ⚡

events.title: Open Playtest is LIVE!
events.summary: Hey everyone! The open playtest for Zap Colony⚡ is live right now and you can jump in immediately.The playtest will run for about a week. After that I’ll be working on fixes and improvements, and then we’ll move into the public demo (in about two weeks if everything goes smoothly). events.title: Devlog #1: Zap Colony Debut Trailer & Progress Update
events.summary: Hello everyone and welcome to my first devlog and announcement on Zap Colony⚡! Today is a big milestone! Just as Steam is rolling out the new video player, I’m releasing the first game trailer, so you can finally see the game in action. The trailer is based on early development builds, but it already gives a glimpse of what Zap Colony is all about and what minimalist style I’m striving for.
